_comment: EXPERIMENT profile 'news-typing' - overlays the default profile (spec 181). Enables the stage-1 news event-typing pass over the spec-177 observation archive: after each unfiltered full run, up to Radar:NewsResearch:Typing:MaxNewTypingsPerRun HOSTED CALLS PER READER are spent typing observations against news-event-taxonomy-v1, split across the three spec-187 §2 lanes: bounded FIFO retries first (MaxRetryTypingsPerRun, oldest last-attempt first), then up to MaxCandidateTypingsPerRun first attempts on the companies this SAME run is about to judge (round-robin, so no one noisy company drains the lane), then every remaining slot on the global queue — window observations newest-first, then the legacy backlog oldest-first, fact families are checkpointed deterministically (fact-family-v2: history-wide segmentation fixes each episode's durable id, projected onto the checkpoint window), and the attention-decomposition artifact is written to <outRoot>/news-typing/live/attention-decomposition-{date}.{md,json} (run-radar.ps1 supplies Radar:NewsResearch:Typing:OutputDirectory). Read-side and shadow: NO score, label, strategy, fingerprint, snapshot field or report rank changes, and nothing is hashed into any fingerprint. The reader is the HOSTED DeepInfra DeepSeek ONLY (same client shape as default.json's Shadow Readers entry 0, requires DEEPINFRA_API_KEY) - the spec-181 §1 gate measured the hosted reader at a 0.0% citation-validation drop rate while llama3.1 dropped 19.2% with near-zero cross-reader agreement, so the local model is NOT a viable solo typing reader and is deliberately absent here. SPEC 187 §8 (2026-08-24): the news-risk shadow no longer schedules the local 'ollama-local' reader either, so this overlay and the baseline both run ONE hosted DeepSeek cohort per stage — a scheduling change only (the Ollama provider, its binding, its tests and the accrued ollama:llama3.1 cohort data are all retained, and cohorts never pool). Cohort identity is provider + exact model id + prompt/schema/TAXONOMY version; capture-mode cohorts (ProspectiveRss vs LegacyHeadlineOnly vs RetrospectiveUrlFetch) never pool in any output. Because this is an overlay, everything else - collectors, strategies, scoring, the news-risk shadow - is byte-identical to the baseline; output routes to data/experiments/news-typing/ so baseline data is untouched.
